source_identity.patent: US 821,393 — 'Flying-Machine', Orville and Wilbur Wright, Dayton, Ohio
source_identity.provenance_lineage: classic-patents.com provenance receipt (owner's sibling project; 300-DPI facsimile review 2026-08-18, page map recorded there); PDF sha256 re-verified at import

group_note: the Wrights' OWN description — same independence group as the diary/telegram evidence (a3) and the 1901 tunnel materials (a1); it may corroborate third-party measurements but never other wright-primary records
evidences: wing warping: lateral margins 'twisted or warped in opposite directions' via cables + operating mechanism connected to the cradle — the mechanism topology behind the E1.5 hip-cradle record, in the inventors' words, FILED BEFORE first flight (1903-03-23)

warp-rudder coordination: a vertical rudder 'operated in conjunction with the movement of the lateral margins... to counteract adverse yaw' — primary corroboration of the slaved-rudder topology (LateralControlTopology::WarpWithSlavedRudder)

front-rudder construction: flexible ribs, springs, rollers, and links (facsimile pp. 7-8) — primary-source corroboration that the canard is a FLEXIBLE variable-camber mechanism, not a rigid plate (the E1.5 Ames/L&P finding, now grounded in a 1903-filed document)
structure: superposed flexible surfaces, pivoted posts, stay-wires (the warp-enabling structure the Culick/Jex report describes)

permitted: mechanism TOPOLOGY and intent (what connects to what, what flexes)
corroborating the variable-camber canard and slaved-rudder findings
forbidden: any QUANTITATIVE ratio, travel, or dimension from patent prose (the patent describes the invention class, not the as-flown 1903 rigging; the flown slaving ratio 2.5 keeps its AIAA provenance)
treating patent drawings as dimensioned engineering drawings
claim_boundaries.note_on_folk_ratios: third-party demos derive small rudder-per-warp ratios (~0.45) from patent-claim readings; any such number is a PATENT-LINEAGE model choice, distinct in provenance and configuration from the flown 2.5 (flyer-reference rudder_warp_slaving) — never merge the two

registry_note: NEW evidence artifact beside the frozen registry (E1.7 freeze law: frozen v1 files are never edited; this file is additive). Integration into a source-dossier v2 happens when the dossier next mints a version.
no_claims: Primary-source registry entry. No physics value enters from here; topology and intent only.
